action: Add action-gate checks and documentation for feedback interpretation, deliverable acceptance, rule-to-action application, plain-language communication, and mistake prevention controls before resuming AURA app fixes.
classification_basis: Ryunosuke reported that prior work repeatedly read rules without applying them, corrected surface examples instead of underlying issues, and risked moving into AURA fixes before all bad points were prevented.

evidence.result: Ryunosuke required prevention mechanisms before app fixes and clarified that the core issue includes written rules not being converted into future action.

applicable_rules: AURA本人受入評価を修正の起点にする
だめだった点をすべて修正できる状態でAURA修正へ進む
ユーザーの例示を表面的な修正項目だけに縮小しない
初心者にも分かる説明へ変換する
内部検証と本人受入を分離する
GitHub連携で実行可能な作業を進める

rule_coverage.reason: Repository controls can affect future delivery claims and file integrity.
rule_coverage.control: No secrets or credentials are added; file integrity remains covered by UTF-8 repository tests.
rule_coverage.evidence: tests/test_repository_text_encoding.py remains part of the PR #28 baseline.
rule_coverage.failure_mode: A future worker could claim safety after reading security rules but skip file-integrity or secret checks.
rule_coverage.action_check: Keep security in rule_coverage and keep encoding/file-integrity tests in the validation set.

rule_coverage.reason: Ryunosuke explicitly approved merging PR #28, then requested prevention mechanisms before app fixes.
rule_coverage.control: Work is limited to a new branch and Draft PR; AURA app repair remains paused.
rule_coverage.failure_mode: A future worker could treat this as approval to begin app repairs immediately.
rule_coverage.action_check: PROJECT_STATE.json and the prevention document must say AURA repair starts only after this control PR is merged.

rule_coverage.reason: The change must turn conversation review failures into tests and blockers.
rule_coverage.control: Unit tests cover missing underlying issue, empty surface examples, empty prevention controls, missing action checks, and missing communication plans.
rule_coverage.failure_mode: A future worker could document good intentions without tests that fail on the bad behavior.
rule_coverage.action_check: Add failing tests for each new gate field before claiming the prevention mechanism exists.

rule_coverage.reason: Prior explanations used terms without enough clarity.
rule_coverage.control: Required handoff needs a plain-language summary, and preflight requires a communication plan when user_communication applies.
rule_coverage.failure_mode: The worker may read the beginner-friendly explanation rule but still answer with unexplained PR, branch, gate, or check language.
rule_coverage.action_check: Before reporting status or handoff, prepare audience, plain-language summary, jargon list, and understanding check.

rule_coverage.reason: PR #28 is merged and PROJECT_STATE.json still pointed at the old branch/status.
rule_coverage.control: Update PROJECT_STATE.json to the prevention-control branch and keep AURA paused until this control PR is reviewed.
rule_coverage.evidence: PROJECT_STATE.json and docs/MISTAKE_PREVENTION_CONTROLS.md in this branch.
rule_coverage.failure_mode: The branch or next action could point to outdated PR #28 or direct AURA repair.
rule_coverage.action_check: Run project-state validation with expected merged PR #28 after final branch updates.

rule_coverage.reason: Prior AURA delivery confused internal testing, public access, and user acceptance.
rule_coverage.control: Completion claims for handoff deliverables require passed internal validation, user-access evidence, and passed user acceptance.
rule_coverage.failure_mode: A worker could call a public URL or internal test pass final acceptance.
rule_coverage.action_check: For completion claims, verify internal validation and Ryunosuke user acceptance separately.

rule_coverage.reason: This work is an incident response to repeated process failures.
rule_coverage.control: Incident steps remain mandatory for mistake responses and this record maps the current response.
rule_coverage.failure_mode: A worker could make a small patch after a mistake without classifying impact or prevention.
rule_coverage.action_check: Mistake responses must complete all incident steps with structured evidence.

rule_coverage.reason: The review clarified that not adding agents was only appropriate for the AURA case, not a permanent policy.
rule_coverage.control: The prevention document requires per-task agent decisions with rationale.
rule_coverage.failure_mode: A future worker could avoid agents by default because it was good in one case.
rule_coverage.action_check: Record whether existing agents are enough, whether temporary help is needed, or whether new skill/agent work is justified for the task.

known_failure_patterns: Rules are read but not converted into action checks.
Beginner-friendly explanation is written as a rule but not applied in user-facing replies.
Feedback examples are narrowed into surface fixes.
Internal validation is mixed with Ryunosuke user acceptance.
A single failed path is treated as impossibility.
Agent decisions are made without recording rationale.
AURA repairs start before prevention controls are merged.

risk_to_action_controls.failure_pattern: Rules are read but not converted into action checks.
risk_to_action_controls.prevention_control: Every applicable rule coverage item must include failure_mode and action_check.
risk_to_action_controls.blocking_check: scripts/check_action_gate.py rejects applicable coverage without both fields.

risk_to_action_controls.failure_pattern: Beginner-friendly explanation is written as a rule but not applied.
risk_to_action_controls.blocking_check: tests/test_action_gate.py covers missing communication_plan and understanding_check.

risk_to_action_controls.failure_pattern: Feedback examples are narrowed into surface fixes.
risk_to_action_controls.prevention_control: Reviewed feedback requires underlying_issue, surface_examples, interpretation_risk, and prevention_controls.
risk_to_action_controls.blocking_check: tests/test_action_gate.py covers missing underlying_issue, surface_examples, and prevention_controls.

communication_plan.plain_language_summary: Explain what changed, what is still blocked, and what was actually verified using ordinary words before jargon.
communication_plan.understanding_check: State the practical next action and separate verified results from pending checks.

positive_patterns: Recovering through an alternate path after one tool path failed was valid and should be preserved.
Not adding a new agent for the AURA case was acceptable only because the existing roles were sufficient for that case.
failures_or_gaps: Rules were read but not applied at the moment of action.
Beginner-friendly explanation was recorded as required but not reliably applied.
Feedback examples were turned into narrow fixes instead of underlying failure patterns.
Internal validation, public access, and Ryunosuke's acceptance were mixed.
AURA fixes were about to begin before all bad points had prevention mechanisms.
feedback_capture.underlying_issue: The central failure is not a missing button or a single visual defect; it is that Codex/Raphael can read instructions and examples, then act on shallow labels instead of applying the user's judgment criteria, acceptance state, communication needs, and recurring failure pattern at the next action boundary.
surface_examples: not adding agents was good in this case
internal tests were reported as fully passing despite file corruption
feedback_capture.interpretation_risk: A later worker may add two named buttons, tweak a character, explain one term, or avoid agents by default, while still failing to predict continued-use behavior, share visual ideals, separate acceptance states, explain status plainly, or decide agent structure per task.
prevention_controls: Require non-empty surface_examples so concrete evidence is not lost.
Require interpretation_risk so the next worker sees how the feedback can be misunderstood.
Require prevention_controls before proceeding from reviewed feedback to implementation.
Require failure_mode and action_check for every applicable rule category.
Require passed user acceptance before completion claims for handoff deliverables.

assignment_decision.rationale: This is a bounded governance/test update on top of PR #28. Creating a new agent before the prevention controls exist would add process weight without improving this specific branch, but the prevention document requires future agent choices to be decided per task.

required_checks: Action gate rejects applicable rule coverage without failure_mode and action_check.
Action gate rejects missing communication_plan when user_communication applies.
Action gate rejects feedback without underlying_issue.
Action gate rejects feedback without surface_examples.
Action gate rejects feedback without prevention_controls.
Action gate rejects completion claims for handoff deliverables without passed user acceptance.
Project state keeps AURA revision paused until prevention controls are merged.
stop_conditions: Do not start AURA app code changes on this branch.
Do not record examples as the whole fix when Ryunosuke describes a broader pattern.
Do not claim tests passed unless they actually ran on the branch head.
Do not treat GitHub Pages reachability as Ryunosuke user acceptance.
Do not answer user-facing status with unexplained jargon when user_communication applies.

evidence.result: Ryunosuke identified the behavior as a repeated process failure that must be prevented before AURA fixes.
Root cause documented as action-boundary rule and feedback interpretation failure.
Impact covers AURA acceptance, visual ideal sharing, continued-use behavior prediction, and feedback interpretation.
Conversation review lists related delivery, explanation, acceptance, and action-gate failures.
Validator now requires feedback underlying issue, interpretation risk, prevention controls, rule action checks, communication plan, and acceptance statuses.
Updated valid record includes the new required feedback, preflight, and communication fields.
A read-but-not-applied rule is covered as a failing case.
No separate agent was used for this narrow control update; future agent decisions remain case-specific.
Ryunosuke approved proceeding after merging PR #28 and required prevention before AURA fixes.
Prevention controls documented before AURA implementation resumes.
A related written-but-not-applied communication rule now fails.
This record captures the current incident response.
